finding: Rejected scalar-reuse prototype was removed; default sequential SSD path validated.
design_implication: Start from clean default behavior; do not revive the head-shared scalar-reuse variant.

finding: Nano HQQ4+k4v4 speed baseline is 346.5 prefill / 94.48 internal decode / 164.75 network.
design_implication: Optimization target is prefill only; decode and HTTP timing are not part of this design gate.

finding: Scalar-reuse prototype regressed SSD/scan by +6262.531ms / +5.472%.
design_implication: New design must be chunk-parallel, not another per-head scalar-reuse variant.

finding: Runtime derives d_inner, n_heads, head_dim, d_state, n_groups, chunk_size, bc_size, conv_dim, and in_proj_dim from config.
design_implication: New path can derive all dimensions from runtime config/tensors; no Nano-specific constants are needed.

finding: Rust currently launches either trace or normal SSD kernel from forward_mamba2 after x/B/C/dt extraction.
design_implication: New path should be an opt-in branch at this dispatch boundary; default branch stays sequential.

finding: Normal path launches self.kernels.mamba2_ssd with grid (n_heads, blocks_d) and shared dA prefix memory.
design_implication: Default production path remains unchanged until the chunk-parallel path passes oracle and speed gates.

finding: Trace path launches mamba2_ssd_trace only for selected-row/device trace diagnostics.
design_implication: Trace can remain sequential initially; do not mix trace instrumentation with the first optimized kernel.

finding: SSD/scan is surrounded by existing Mamba2 timing instrumentation.
design_implication: New gated path can reuse this timing bucket for old/new diagnostic comparison.

finding: PTX required symbols currently include only mamba2_ssd_sequential_kernel and trace variant.
design_implication: Follow-up patch must add explicit required symbols for each new chunk-parallel kernel and fail closed if missing.

finding: RawCuFunc handles currently bind normal and trace SSD kernels only.
design_implication: Follow-up patch must add separate RawCuFunc fields for prepare, cb, output, and state-update kernels.

finding: Existing Mamba2 scratch includes ssm_state [heads, head_dim, state] FP32, in_proj [max_tokens, in_proj_dim] BF16, and ssd_out [max_tokens, d_inner] BF16.
design_implication: New path needs small per-chunk scratch, not another max-token output buffer except oracle mode.

finding: Shim documents intended chunked SSD: chunk size, parallel scan within chunks, sequential state passing between chunks.
design_implication: This is the right algorithmic direction for the next implementation gate.

finding: Helpers define A=-exp(A_log), softplus(dt+bias), C dot B in reverse state order, and shared dA prefix scan.
design_implication: New kernels must reuse the same casts/order or compare against the sequential oracle.

finding: Current kernel explicitly says it is a simple sequential scan equivalent to decode N times.
design_implication: Source-level cause remains algorithmic; current kernel should become the oracle, not the optimized path.

finding: Each valid d updates recurrent state for every t and state element.
design_implication: Chunk design must preserve final ssm_state exactly because decode consumes it.

finding: Output uses prior chunk state plus HF-compatible local chunk emission.
design_implication: Design must split prior-state contribution from current-chunk triangular emission.

finding: For each d and each t, kernel scans u from chunk_start to t.
design_implication: This is the triangular in-chunk work that should become parallel over chunk positions.

finding: C[t] dot B[u] is recomputed for every d even though it depends only on group,t,u.
design_implication: New path should compute CB once per group,t,u per chunk, then reuse it across heads and head_dim.

finding: Current prior-state correction recomputes C dot B_bar per d/u for non-first chunks.
design_implication: New path should compute prior term directly from chunk entry state instead of computing then subtracting current-chunk update.

finding: Trace summary kernel encodes state, update, chunk formula, and local scan diagnostics.
design_implication: These modes define the comparison points for a correctness oracle.

finding: Request-gated output detail recomputes c_state_total, local_old_state, and local_hf_chunk_scan.
design_implication: Useful for diagnosing oracle mismatch without modifying production output.

finding: Local scan detail records per-u term variants and BF16 scale behavior.
design_implication: Oracle failure should reuse this path to identify cast/order mismatch.

finding: Shadow context detail exposes C/B pointer/index and local-scan context.
design_implication: Useful for source-level mismatch attribution in the follow-up implementation gate.

finding: Diagnostic CPU SSD helper mirrors sequential math for last-token output/state.
design_implication: It can remain a secondary debugging check, but GPU sequential kernel is the primary oracle.

finding: Existing LA path split a too-complex chunk recurrence into multiple simpler kernels orchestrated from Rust.
design_implication: Mamba2 follow-up should use the same conservative multi-kernel orchestration rather than one monolithic cooperative kernel.

finding: LA chunk kernels have focused GPU tests for compute/output/state update.
design_implication: Mamba2 chunk kernels need analogous focused tests before any long diagnostic run.
